requirement.description: Several test failures show that build_netlist is returning tuples instead of dictionaries, causing AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' when trying to iterate over attributes.
requirement.contract: When build_netlist processes fragments, it should return a Netlist object that properly serializes to a dictionary format with 'items()' method available for iteration. The netlist should correctly serialize all components including switches, assertions, and other constructs.
requirement.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'items' should now pass, specifically: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_print, tests/test_back_rtlil.py::SwitchTestCase::test_simple, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_comb, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_sync, tests/test_lib_coding.py::PriorityEncoderTestCase::test_basic, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_assert, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_comb, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_sync, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::SwitchTestCase::test_assert, tests/test_back_rtlil.py::SwitchTestCase::test_nested, tests/test_back_rtlil.py::SwitchTestCase::test_trivial, tests/test_hdl_dsl.py::DSLTestCase::test_FSM_basic, tests/test_hdl_dsl.py::DSLTestCase::test_FSM_reset, tests/test_hdl_dsl.py::DSLTestCase::test_FSM_init, tests/test_lib_fifo.py::AsyncFIFOSimCase::test_async_fifo_r_level_latency, tests/test_lib_crc.py::CRCTestCase::test_crc_match, tests/test_lib_crc.py::CRCTestCase::test_crc_bytes, tests/test_lib_crc.py::CRCTestCase::test_crc_words, tests/test_lib_coding.py::DecoderTestCase::test_basic, tests/test_lib_coding.py::EncoderTestCase::test_basic, tests/test_back_rtlil.py::SwitchTestCase::test_aba, tests/test_back_rtlil.py::PrintTestCase::test_assert_simple

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect implementation of error handling for duplicate elaboration and domain conflicts.
requirement.contract: Functions that check for duplicate elaboration and domain conflicts should properly raise DuplicateElaboratable and DriverConflict exceptions with appropriate error messages to match test expectations.
requirement.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with assertion errors about missing exceptions should now pass, specifically: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::DuplicateElaboratableTestCase::test_duplicate, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::ConflictTestCase::test_domain_conflict, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::ConflictTestCase::test_module_conflict, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::ConflictTestCase::test_instance_conflict

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of domain propagation and assignment in netlist generation.
requirement.contract: Domain propagation and assignment should correctly handle all combinations of domains including sync, async_reset, reset_less, and local domains. The netlist generation should properly create assignments and handle domain-specific statements.
requirement.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with assertion errors or incorrect netlist generation should now pass, specifically: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_up, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_up_local, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_domain_conflict, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_domain_conflict_anon, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_domain_conflict_name, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_domain_conflict_rename_drivers, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_domain_conflict_rename_drivers_before_creating_missing, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_down, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_down_idempotent, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate

requirement.description: Improper handling of signal names and assignments in netlist generation.
